Down at [Location], the place got utterly smashed in a storm and needs some serious patchwork.

If anyone out there has a bunch of fuses (I hear six should be plenty), a salvaging tool, and enough RMC cans to deal with eight or so messed up pipes, we'll hook you up with some creds to do the fix.

Hopefully you know what you're doing, but just in case, the “Guide to Maintenance” in your mobiGlas Journal might be worth a look.

Stows out.
